# I-Cost

> I-Cost is construction estimating, procurement, cost control and carbon software for UK contractors. The client's BOQ, the estimate, client quotations, supplier quotes, purchase orders, deliveries, site timesheets, the programme and cost and carbon reports sit in one place, so contractors can see the forecast margin on every project. £35 per user per month after a 7-day free trial (no bank card needed). Suppliers use the supplier portal free.

I-Cost is for UK main contractors and specialist subcontractors: commercial directors, quantity surveyors, estimators, buyers, project and site managers, sustainability leads and finance teams. It runs in the browser and installs like an app on phone, tablet and PC.

What I-Cost does:
- Estimating and BOQ: import the client's Excel or CSV bill of quantities with a total check, or quantities from a BIM model (IFC, beta); cost and selling rates with margin; libraries; a price check that flags copied items bought since at a different price; locked final estimates and revisions.
- Client quotations: quotation PDF from the estimate at selling prices, negotiated discount, accepted revision becomes the agreed contract sum used in every report.
- Suppliers and quotes: one quotation request to several suppliers, suggested suppliers, a free supplier portal, side-by-side price comparison, order from the lowest quote.
- Purchase orders and deliveries: drafts and revisions, order progress from suppliers, QR delivery notes, goods received, accruals, credit notes, an Item tracker from request to invoice, supply chain view.
- Cost control and reporting: approved cost budget (versioned), committed and incurred cost, forecast final cost, cost to complete and forecast margin by area and cost type; the records behind every figure; project report as Word or PDF; CSV for Excel.
- Programme: Gantt programme from the estimate's sections, late and upcoming work, Excel download, time summary across projects.
- Timesheets: hours logged on a phone, site gangs, design tasks, approvals with send back, costed at hourly rates.
- Carbon: embodied carbon on every estimate line from UK ICE data or EPDs; whole life carbon assessments (beta) covering stages A1-A5, B1-B7, C1-C4 and D, following the RICS Professional Standard (2nd edition) and BS EN 15978.
- Team and support: roles and permissions, read-only Reviewer, team chat, guided tutorial, Costa in-app help assistant, Help Desk, hourly off-site backups, data export at any time.

Not in I-Cost yet: valuations, payment applications and a variations register.

Why real prices matter: AI tools can help draft an estimate but do not know today's prices from your suppliers. UK top-100 contractors average a 2.4% pre-tax margin (The Construction Index, 2025), UK material prices rose 6.4% in the year to August 2026 (Department for Business and Trade), and avoidable errors cost around 21% of project value (Get It Right Initiative / CITB). I-Cost keeps supplier quotes and your own purchase order prices in one place.

## Solutions

- [Construction project management software](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-project-management-software/): run the commercial side of every job, from estimate to final report
- [Construction estimating software](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-estimating-software/): import the client BOQ or a BIM model, price it and quote the client; how to price a BOQ
- [Construction supplier management](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-supplier-management/): quotes from several suppliers side by side, a free supplier portal, managing subcontractors
- [Construction purchase order software](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-purchase-order-software/): orders, QR delivery notes, goods received, invoices and committed cost
- [Construction cost and budget tracking](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-cost-tracking/): approved budget, committed cost, forecast final cost and margin
- [Construction timesheet app](https://i-cost.co.uk/construction-timesheet-app/): site hours on a phone, gangs, approvals and labour cost
- [Embodied carbon calculator](https://i-cost.co.uk/embodied-carbon-calculator/): carbon from the estimate, and whole life carbon assessments A1 to D following RICS
